title: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe is live on OpenPak
body: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe is live on OpenPak. On 20 September a real Switch and an emulator together completed four full races, so the race flow has been played end to end on a console. The game's online service is served by OpenPak, and we keep testing it as more players join. Gather your friends and get your engines running.
footer: OpenPak Mario Kart 8 Deluxe — playable, not promised.
